release_notes: Ask: answers from Gemini right in the island, with web results, live model list and automatic fallback when a model hits its limit
Translate between 160 languages, plus quick maths and currency conversion as you type
Copy text from anything on screen (Ctrl + Alt + T) with offline Windows OCR
AI Agents: watch Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents, and approve their permission requests from the island
New widgets: to-do list, water reminder, internet speed test and screenshots with a built-in editor
Ambient mode (Ctrl + Alt + F): full-screen lyrics in four styles
Browser tabs no longer hidden: choose slim line, corner, reserved space or see-through in Settings › General
Brand-new Settings window with search and grouped sections
Scrollable tab bar with arrows; the island stays closed while a panel is open
Sharper album art and many smaller fixes
